sessions.name: Workshop | Breathwork: Somatic Breath
sessions.description:
Somatic Breath is a powerful breathing practice that focuses on releasing trauma by gently unwinding the acute and chronic tensions held in the body. Over time, chronic patterns of tension dampen life force, suppress emotional expression, alter perception, compromise movement, and eventually lead to disease. The focus of this modality is on completing the interrupted fight-and-flight responses stored deep within our nervous system and cellular memory.

In this workshop, we will explore self-help techniques by actively participating in our own healing process. Using conscious, connected breathing, movement, vocal expression, and self-applied touch, we support the body in releasing stored tension. Rather than focusing on the problem, we learn to follow the expressions of health.

By learning to monitor our own levels of activation, we take charge of our healing. We deepen our experience by connecting with the felt sense, using it to self-regulate the nervous system and attune to the subtle ways the body lets go.

The body can only release when it is ready. We never over-activate or force the process. This approach is safe and gentle, promoting a deep connection with ourselves in an open and loving way. We surrender the mind to the body’s innate intelligence.

DATE & TIME
November 12 | 14:00 - 16:30

PRICE
350.000 IDR

ABOUT NIRMOHA
With decades of experience in embodied approaches to healing trauma, Nirmoha offers profound and effective support for individuals and groups seeking release and transformation. Through her expertise, she guides participants into a deep exploration of the breath, enabling them to access and release stored tensions and traumas. With skillful techniques and compassionate guidance, Nirmoha empowers people from all walks of life to experience deep healing and lasting positive change.

sessions.name: Community | Women's Circle
sessions.description:
Women’s Circle is a space for women to gather in community, slow down, and reconnect with themselves and one another.

Throughout different stages of life, women experience continual changes in their bodies, relationships, identities, responsibilities, and aspirations. Yet there are often few spaces where these experiences can be explored openly and honestly.

This circle offers an opportunity to step away from the demands of everyday life and create space for reflection, connection, and authentic expression.

Through guided sharing, conscious listening, embodiment, reflection, and meaningful conversation, we explore themes such as self-worth, relationships, boundaries, emotional expression, feminine identity, life transitions, purpose, and personal growth.

The intention is not to provide answers or fix what is perceived as a problem. Instead, the circle invites each woman to listen inwardly, share from her own experience, and be witnessed by a supportive community.

Participants are welcome to share only what feels comfortable for them. There is no requirement to speak, and confidentiality, respect, and compassionate listening are central to the circle.

DATE & TIME
Every Sunday | 17:00 - 19:00

FREE COMMUNITY EVENT
Donations are welcome

sessions.name: Kirtan | Kirtan
sessions.description:
Join Alexandra for an evening of kirtan, a joyful and meditative practice from the bhakti yoga tradition that brings people together through music, mantra, and shared intention. Through call-and-response chanting accompanied by harmonium and percussion, we create a space to connect with ourselves, one another, and the heart of the practice.

No previous experience with chanting, singing, or yoga is necessary. You do not need to be musical to participate. Whether you choose to sing along, sit quietly in meditation, or simply listen and receive, you are welcome exactly as you are.

Alexandra weaves together traditional Sanskrit mantras with stories and teachings from the yoga tradition, creating an experience that is both grounding and uplifting. The repetitive nature of the chants helps settle the mind, open the heart, and cultivate a sense of peace, joy, and connection. Many students find kirtan to be a moving meditation—a practice that invites presence, devotion, and a deeper sense of community.

Expect an evening filled with mantra, music, and moments of stillness. There is no performance and no pressure to participate in any particular way. You are welcome to sit, sing, clap, meditate, or gently move with the rhythm of the chants.

Rooted in the tradition of bhakti yoga and guided by Alexandra’s love of mantra and philosophy, this gathering offers an opportunity to step away from the busyness of daily life and experience the simple yet profound practice of chanting together.

Come as you are and experience the transformative power of voice, vibration, and community. No experience is required—all are welcome.

DATE & TIME
November 21 | 18:00 - 19:30

PRICE
Regular price: 220.000 IDR
Early bird price: 190.000 IDR | Valid until November 20

ABOUT ALEXANDRA
Alexandra McRobert is a yoga teacher, kirtan leader, and student of yoga philosophy. Her classes blend movement, meditation, mantra, and teachings from the Yoga Sutras to create practices that support both body and mind.
She is passionate about the path of Bhakti Yoga and loves sharing the joy of chanting in community. Alexandra has trained hundreds of yoga teachers through her Bali-based teacher trainings and leads retreats and philosophy programs around the world.

sessions.name: Event | Full Moon Ceremony with Fire Ritual, Biomagnetism & Sound Healing
sessions.description:
This Full Moon Ceremony offers a sacred and intentional space to pause, reconnect, and explore what is ready to shift within. Over the course of two hours, this immersive experience brings together somatic movement, guided meditation, sound healing, biomagnetism, and intentional ritual to create space for connection, reflection, and inner exploration. An invitation to step away from the demands of everyday life, quiet the noise of the mind, and return to the wisdom of the body.

The Full Moon in Gemini invites us to explore our relationship with our thoughts, beliefs, communication, and inner dialogue. Associated with curiosity, movement, and new perspectives, Gemini reminds us that transformation can begin when we become willing to question the stories we tell ourselves and see our lives through a different lens. This lunar moment invites us to recognize patterns of thinking that may be keeping us stuck, release outdated beliefs, and create space for greater clarity, openness, and possibility.

Our minds hold incredible power, yet sometimes the constant flow of thoughts, expectations, and external influences can disconnect us from what we truly feel and need. Under this lunar energy, we are invited to slow down and listen more deeply. What thoughts are you ready to release? What truths have you been avoiding? Where are you holding on to stories that no longer reflect who you are becoming? And what might become possible if you allowed yourself to see things differently?

Throughout the ceremony, participants will be guided through embodied practices designed to bring awareness into the body and create space for whatever is ready to emerge. Somatic movement offers an opportunity to explore sensations, soften tension, and reconnect with the body's natural rhythms, while guided meditation and reflection invite us to observe our thoughts without becoming consumed by them. Through intentional practices and moments of stillness, we create space to distinguish between the noise of the mind and the quieter voice of our inner wisdom.

Working with the symbolism of the four directions and elemental forces, the ceremony unfolds as a journey through movement, ritual, and reflection. Fire becomes a central symbol of transformation, helping us acknowledge what we are ready to leave behind and consciously make space for what we wish to cultivate. Through a sacred fire ritual, we will be invited to release limiting beliefs, old patterns, and emotional weight, transforming our intentions into a meaningful reminder of the possibilities that lie ahead.

Sound healing and biomagnetism will complement the experience, offering moments of relaxation, presence, and deeper connection with the body. Through sound, stillness, and intentional awareness, we will create space to soften the constant activity of the mind and become more receptive to the experience unfolding within us. Rather than striving to achieve a particular outcome, this is an opportunity to simply be present, listen, and allow yourself to receive.

The ceremony will close with meditation and intentional integration, allowing time to reflect on the insights, sensations, and intentions that have emerged. This final moment invites you to carry the experience beyond the ceremony itself, bringing greater awareness into your everyday choices, relationships, and the way you speak to yourself.

The Gemini Full Moon reminds us that we are not our thoughts, nor are we bound to the stories we have carried until now. We have the capacity to question, reimagine, communicate more honestly, and choose new ways of relating to ourselves and the world around us. Sometimes, the shift we need does not come from doing more, but from creating enough stillness to recognize what is no longer true for us.

This ceremony is an invitation to honor the journey you have walked, release what no longer resonates, and welcome new perspectives with curiosity and intention. A sacred pause to reconnect with yourself, create space for clarity, and remember that you have the freedom to choose a different story.

BENEFITS:
- Supports emotional clearing and energetic release
- Encourages balance, harmony, and inner recalibration
- Facilitates nervous system regulation and embodied presence
- Supports self-reflection and conscious integration
- Enhances emotional awareness and intuitive insight
- Fosters connection, belonging, and shared presence within a women’s circle

*No prior experience required.
*To prepare for the ceremony, wear comfortable clothing that allows ease of movement and bring a journal for reflection.

AGENDA:
- Arrival, welcome, and anointing ritual
- Introduction to the ceremonial container
- Overview of the energetics of the Full Moon in Scorpio
- Opening circle
- Cleansing rituals
- Guided journaling for reflection and intention
- Somatic movement to support energetic alignment
- Calming and grounding practices to prepare the body and nervous system
- Guided alchemical meditation with sound healing and biomagnetism
- Closing circle with optional sharing and integration

DATE & TIME
November 24 | 18:00 - 20:00

PRICE
Regular price: 550.000 IDR
Early bird price: 440.000 IDR | Valid until November 19

Constanza is a ceremonial facilitator and integrative therapist, guiding cacao, lotus, fire, and sound ceremonies that hold space for deep healing and transformation. Some describe vivid inner visions and extraordinary imagery, reminiscent of psychedelic experiences, emerging naturally through sound alone. Others speak of a profound sense of coming home, of feeling deeply embodied and fully present, or of reconnecting with themselves on a soul level, as if remembering something they had always known but somehow forgotten.

As the vibrations travel through your body, emotions, mind, and inner world, you may find yourself moving beyond the familiar boundaries of perception. Through harmonic singing, overtone resonance, and channeled vocal expression, sound becomes more than something you hear. It surrounds you, moves through you, and unfolds within you, inviting you into an immersive landscape of vibration, sensation, and inner discovery.

Let yourself be enchanted by Mysticlio’s unique multidimensional vocal transmission, lie down, surrender and receive. You may experience profound relaxation, emotional release, unexpected imagery, expanded awareness, or a quiet yet powerful reconnection with your authentic essence. There is no experience you need to have and nothing you need to force. Your journey is entirely your own.

Enter a space where vibration becomes sensation, listening becomes exploration, and sound becomes a doorway to remembrance.

Come as you are. Lie down. Let the sound find you.
